selectionPolicy.note: Require cash=true or cash=1 except reviewed skin codes; exclude shields, reviewed event rewards and Meister symbols. Exclude non-label tops/bottoms with known popularity.usedCount <= 5. Acquisition review is partial; unreviewed cash items remain. Master and special labels share priority; reviewed stat-package items sort last, then popularity.usedCount (fallback: original usedCount). Original source observations are preserved.

catalogReview.note: All displayed items cross-checked by item code against label pages and refreshed slot usage statistics. Original rank/usedCount fields preserved; popularity contains the new observations.
